title: Document autonomous PR flow + public-repo security posture
body:
Hardening follow-up: documents the autonomous PR→checks→auto-merge flow and updates security docs now that the repo is public.

This PR is also the **end-to-end test of the auto-merge loop** — it should merge itself once all required checks pass, with no human review.
